genes.name: CF transmembrane conductance regulator
genes.function: cAMP-activated chloride and bicarbonate channel in epithelial cells.
genes.disease_evidence: Disease-causing variants in CFTR cause cystic fibrosis.

genes.name: solute carrier family 26 member 9
genes.function: Anion transporter that modulates chloride and bicarbonate transport in airway and intestinal epithelia.
genes.disease_evidence: SLC26A9 is a genetic modifier of cystic fibrosis lung and intestinal disease.

genes.name: sodium channel epithelial 1 subunit alpha
genes.function: Alpha subunit of the epithelial sodium channel (ENaC), which drives airway surface liquid absorption.
genes.disease_evidence: ENaC-mediated sodium absorption contributes to airway dehydration when CFTR function is lost.

genes.name: transforming growth factor beta 1
genes.function: Profibrotic cytokine that regulates extracellular matrix production and epithelial repair.
genes.disease_evidence: TGFB1 variants modify cystic fibrosis lung disease severity.

genes.name: tumor necrosis factor
genes.function: Pro-inflammatory cytokine that coordinates neutrophil recruitment and airway inflammation.
genes.disease_evidence: TNF promoter variants are associated with clinical status in cystic fibrosis.

genes.name: C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 8
genes.function: IL-8 chemokine that recruits neutrophils to inflamed airways.
genes.disease_evidence: CXCL8 is elevated in cystic fibrosis airway inflammation and is reduced by CFTR modulator therapy.

genes.name: mannose binding lectin 2
genes.function: Pattern-recognition lectin that activates complement and promotes opsonophagocytosis.
genes.disease_evidence: MBL2 insufficiency is associated with a more severe cystic fibrosis course.

genes.name: solute carrier family 11 member 1
genes.function: NRAMP1 metal transporter involved in macrophage iron and manganese handling.
genes.disease_evidence: SLC11A1 variants are associated with cystic fibrosis clinical severity.

genes.name: heme oxygenase 1
genes.function: Heme oxygenase that degrades heme to biliverdin, iron, and carbon monoxide.
genes.disease_evidence: HMOX1 methylation and expression are altered in cystic fibrosis airway disease.

genes.name: solute carrier family 6 member 14
genes.function: Sodium- and chloride-dependent transporter of neutral and cationic amino acids.
genes.disease_evidence: SLC6A14 variants are associated with cystic fibrosis clinical severity.

genes.name: interferon gamma receptor 1
genes.function: Interferon gamma receptor subunit that activates JAK-STAT1 antimicrobial responses.
genes.disease_evidence: IFNGR1 variants modify cystic fibrosis disease manifestation.

genes.name: potassium calcium-activated channel subfamily N member 4
genes.function: Calcium-activated potassium channel KCa3.1 that drives epithelial ion secretion.
genes.disease_evidence: Kcnn4 is a modifier of intestinal cystic fibrosis in CFTR-F508del mice.

genes.name: serpin family A member 1
genes.function: Alpha-1 antitrypsin, a serine protease inhibitor produced in the liver and lung.
genes.disease_evidence: SERPINA1 variants modify cystic fibrosis-associated liver disease.

genes.name: homeostatic iron regulator
genes.function: MHC class I-like iron sensor that regulates hepcidin and iron homeostasis.
genes.disease_evidence: HFE C282Y is associated with more severe cystic fibrosis lung disease.

genes.name: derlin 1
genes.function: ER-associated degradation retrotranslocation factor for misfolded secretory proteins.
genes.disease_evidence: DERL1-dependent ERAD is part of the protein quality-control network that handles misfolded CFTR.

genes.name: SEL1L adaptor subunit of SYVN1 ubiquitin ligase
genes.function: ERAD adaptor that recruits misfolded substrates to the HRD1 ubiquitin ligase.
genes.disease_evidence: SEL1L-mediated ERAD is implicated in disposal of misfolded CFTR.
